rationale: Inside this one frozen review, both sealed pair roles contain material-difference and no-material-difference outcomes. Within-condition comparisons include divergence in both rehearsal_direct and rehearsal_direct_plus_current_one_hop draws, as well as convergence within the graph condition. Cross-condition comparisons likewise include both divergence and convergence. The frozen move forms also recur across the role boundary: independent-evidence gates, credibility tests or falsifiers, claim-to-evidence mapping, identity or prestige counterframes, separation of channel expansion from broader validation, and commitment-asymmetry cautions appear in different combinations rather than forming a condition-exclusive pattern. Accordingly, the revealed cross-condition differences are not distinguishable from the variation already observed within conditions in this frozen review. This is a qualitative recurrence interpretation only: it does not score occurrences, estimate an effect, attribute causation, assess correctness or usefulness, or select a condition or answer.
